name: The agent CLI crashes, the next need resumes it
note: PRD section 6, 'Agent CLI crashes': session marked dead; the next need resumes it with the same session id. Not drawn in the PRD; written by the trace task (docs/prd/progress/trace.md).
source: docs/prd/k2-distributed-runtime.html, section 6 (When things die), row 'Agent CLI crashes'; flow by docs/prd/progress/trace.md

steps.label: POST /cli/sessions/v2/spawn
steps.say: The client opens the agent, exactly as in the spawn flow.

steps.label: Spawn{agent, harness, session_id}
steps.say: The agent's provider session id is fixed at spawn (claude --session-id).

steps.label: exec claude --session-id <id>
steps.say: The CLI starts a new conversation with that id.

steps.label: a turn starts
steps.say: A prompt arrives and the CLI begins a turn.

steps.label: the CLI dies mid-turn (kill -9)
steps.say: The PTY host sees the child exit by a signal, not a clean exit. The turn in progress is what can be lost (PRD section 6).

steps.label: session marked dead
steps.say: The host marks the session dead and drops it from the live set; the agent's home and provider session id stay.

steps.label: the next need: POST /cli/sessions/v2/spawn (no command)
steps.say: Today the need is a tab visit, a message or a heartbeat. Nothing respawns the CLI before that.

steps.label: Spawn{agent, resume_id}
steps.say: The controller resumes the saved provider session id instead of starting fresh.

steps.label: exec claude --resume <id>
steps.say: Same session id, same transcript and memory files (invariant I3).

steps.label: hook SessionStart (source resume)
steps.say: Hooks flow again, as in the hook flow.

steps.label: AgentEvent{SessionStart, attested}
steps.say: The controller sees the agent back.
